ai_summary: Adani Total Gas Limited has formally appointed Mr. Preyash Jhaveri as its Chief Financial Officer, effective September 3, 2026. This appointment, which transitions him from his interim CFO role since December 2025, solidifies the company's financial leadership with an experienced professional boasting over 30 years in finance and a long tenure with Adani. The move suggests continuity and stability in financial management, with no immediate red flags identified.
